full_details: You heard the cry at the lodging and did not go down to it. At the stage door, before Two Gentlemen, John and Garnish settled Thursday in a dozen words, and Garnish took the bill down. The play itself is not kept. At supper you read Anne's letter aloud. Mistress Ansell asked what they do in that town, and you said they malt. She said they dry it too near the thatch. Of tomorrow she gave no ruling, which you have not known her do. Verbeke said a longer grace, in his own tongue. Upstairs you wrote five lines. The house here goes dark on Saturday. You set out Monday, on foot, by Banbury. You look to be at the bridge on Thursday, the last of July. You did not write that you had read her last instruction. The almanac got two words.
one_sentence: By noon the street had cried tomorrow on Tower Hill, and after supper you wrote Anne five lines.
title: Five lines to Anne
